elements.element: Vendor provides transition assistance on expiry or termination
elements.evidence: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Licensor shall (i) ... provide reasonable transition assistance

elements.element: Transition assistance available for up to 6 months
elements.evidence: for a period of up to six (6) months

elements.element: Transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates
Return of Customer Data within 30 days of expiry or termination (not a later request)
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days of Licensee's request, return to Licensee all Licensee data

up to six (6) months at Licensor's then-current rates

elements.element: Data export/return within 30 days of expiry or termination
elements.evidence: within thirty (30) days of Licensee's request

offending_extra_words: Licensor shall not delete or withhold access to such data prior to completing the return described in clause (ii).
reasons: The 30-day return clock runs from "Licensee's request" rather than from expiry or termination, so the mandatory post-termination data return is conditioned on a request; both the preferred and fallback return elements fail. Fix by deleting "of Licensee's request" and inserting "of such expiry or termination".
Transition assistance duration (up to six months) and then-current rates satisfy the preferred position; the request condition on assistance alone would be acceptable, but not on the return deadline.
Format wording "commonly used, machine-readable" is read as satisfying "standard machine-readable format"; deletion and written certification follow the return as required.

Minimality fails: the closing sentence "Licensor shall not delete or withhold access to such data prior to completing the return described in clause (ii)" duplicates the protection already achieved by "thereafter delete" sequencing in clause (iii) and is unnecessary boilerplate.
Untouched terms in Article XXI (Licensee's return of Licensed Technology and Licensor's survival) remain effective; no undefined term or contradiction is introduced.
